## Waiver (Wa)

Excuses one obligation without changing the text — "we will not enforce the late fee for March." Scope is the legally dangerous part and therefore a field: one-time expires with its occasion; ongoing can read as abandoning the right, so the card warns when ongoing lacks an expiry.

### Non-goals

No enforcement logic — a waiver is a record the humans honor; nothing here mutes Invoice late fees automatically.
